NTLMv1AuthenticationProtocol: SELECT DOMAINNAME(domainId) AS 'domainName',"Source Workstation" as 'Source Workstation',domainId AS 'Domain', DATEFORMAT(starttime,'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss.SSS a Z') AS 'Start Time', LOGSOURCENAME(logSourceId) AS 'Log Source',sourceIP  AS  'Source IP', "userName" AS 'Username', sum(eventCount) AS 'Event Count' from events WHERE DOMAINNAME(domainId) != '{customer_name}'  AND userName NOT ILIKE ENUMERATION('%$%', '%SYSTEM%') GROUP BY "Source Workstation",sourceIP,LOGSOURCENAME(logSourceId),userName START '{start_time}' STOP '{stop_time}' PARAMETERS REMOTESERVERS=ARIELSERVERS4EPNAME(PROCESSORNAME({event_processor}))
O365BasicAuthentication: SELECT DOMAINNAME(domainId) AS 'domainName',"Application Name" as 'Application Name',CATEGORYNAME(category) AS 'Low Level Category',"Object ID" as 'Object ID',"userName" AS 'Username', domainId AS 'Domain', DATEFORMAT(starttime,'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss.SSS a Z') AS 'Start Time',sum(eventCount) AS 'Event Count',"User Agent" as 'User Agent' from events WHERE DOMAINNAME(domainId) != '{customer_name}' AND "User Agent" ILIKE '%BAV2ROPC%' AND CATEGORYNAME(category) = 'User Login Success' GROUP BY userName,"Object ID","Application Name" START '{start_time}' STOP '{stop_time}' PARAMETERS REMOTESERVERS=ARIELSERVERS4EPNAME(PROCESSORNAME({event_processor}))
ExcessivePrivileges: SELECT DOMAINNAME(domainId) AS 'domainName',"Event ID" as 'Event ID',"Account Security ID" as 'Account Security ID', domainId AS 'Domain', DATEFORMAT(starttime,'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss.SSS a Z') AS 'Start Time',LOGSOURCENAME(logSourceId) AS 'Log Source', "userName" AS 'Username', "Privileges" AS 'Privileges (custom)',sum(eventCount) AS 'Event Count' from events WHERE DOMAINNAME(domainId) != '{customer_name}' AND "Privileges" ILIKE ENUMERATION('%SeDebugPrivilege%', '%SeLoadDriverPrivilege%','%SeDebugPrivilege%', '%SeTcbPrivilege%','%SeLoadDriverPrivilege%','%SeBackupPrivilege%', '%SeRestorePrivilege%','%SeTakeOwnershipPrivilege%', '%SeManageVolumePrivilege%') AND "Event ID"=4672 AND userName NOT ILIKE ENUMERATION('%$%','%SYSTEM%','%LOCAL SERVICE%' , '%NETWORK%' , '%DWM%') GROUP BY "Account Security ID","Privileges" START '{start_time}' STOP '{stop_time}' PARAMETERS REMOTESERVERS=ARIELSERVERS4EPNAME(PROCESSORNAME({event_processor}))
LowerEncryptionRC4: SELECT DOMAINNAME(domainId) AS 'domainName', domainId AS 'Domain', DATEFORMAT(starttime,'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss.SSS a Z') AS 'Start Time', "userName" AS 'Username', "Ticket Encryption Type" AS 'Ticket Encryption Type (custom)', "sourceIP" AS 'Source IP', LOGSOURCENAME(logSourceId) AS 'Log Source', sum(eventCount) AS 'Event Count' from events WHERE DOMAINNAME(domainId) != '{customer_name}' AND "Ticket Encryption Type" IN ('0x17') GROUP BY LOGSOURCENAME(logSourceId),"sourceIP","userName" START '{start_time}' STOP '{stop_time}' PARAMETERS REMOTESERVERS=ARIELSERVERS4EPNAME(PROCESSORNAME({event_processor}))
LogonType8ClearText: SELECT DOMAINNAME(domainId) AS 'domainName', domainId AS 'Domain',"Process Path" as 'Process Path (custom)', DATEFORMAT(starttime,'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss.SSS a Z') AS 'Start Time',"Account Security ID" as 'Account Security ID', "userName" AS 'Username', "Logon Type" AS 'Logon Type (custom)', LOGSOURCENAME(logSourceId) AS 'Log Source', sum(eventCount) AS 'Event Count' from events WHERE DOMAINNAME(domainId) != '{customer_name}' AND "Logon Type"='8' AND "Process Path" <> null AND "Process Path" NOT ILIKE ENUMERATION('Citrix\Broker\Service\BrokerService.exe' ,'Citrix\Receiver StoreFront\') GROUP BY LOGSOURCENAME(logSourceId),"Process Path","userName","Account Security ID" START '{start_time}' STOP '{stop_time}' PARAMETERS REMOTESERVERS=ARIELSERVERS4EPNAME(PROCESSORNAME({event_processor}))
